data.title: BTC Digital Ltd. Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement Following Prior Deficiency Notice
data.description: Today, September 4, 2026, BTC Digital Ltd. (NASDAQ: BTCT), a digital computing infrastructure company listed on Nasdaq, disclosed that it received written notification from The Nasdaq Stock Exchange regarding its listing qualifications.

data.title: In HelloNation, Shed Expert Keith Kirwin Explains Permit Requirements for Backyard Sheds
data.description: This article explores the impact of both homeowner association regulations and local permit requirements on shed installation projects. Released on September 4, 2026, in Charleston, South Carolina, the article by HelloNation discusses the necessity of permits for installing backyard sheds. It analyzes how adherence to HOA guidelines and obtaining local permits can influence the successful execution of shed installation projects.

data.title: McRae Industries, Inc. Dividend Declared
data.description: In Mount Gilead, North Carolina, on September 4, 2026, McRae Industries, Inc. announced a dividend of $.14 per share for both its Class A and Class B Common Stock. Shareholders of record on September 17, 2026, will receive this dividend, with the payment scheduled for October 1, 2026. The company's stocks, traded as MCRAA and MCRAB on the Pink Sheets, will be affected by this declaration.

data.title: ZIEGLER ADVISES THE SALE OF THE VILLAGE AT ANTHONY BOULEVARD
data.description: Specialty investment bank Ziegler recently served as the exclusive sell-side financial advisor to Lutheran Life Villages (LLV) in the sale of The Village at Anthony Boulevard. The Community, a 346-unit continuum campus situated in Chicago, was the subject of the transaction. This deal marks a significant transaction in the industry, reflecting the continued growth and activity in the senior living sector.

data.title: The World's Largest Matched Pair Of Flawless, Unheated Paraiba Tourmalines Go To Auction At Sotheby's
data.description: In Toronto on September 4, 2026, it was announced that on September 17, 2026, at 02:00 AM EDT, the 'Kat Florence Luminas' will set a new world record as it is set to be auctioned off live through Sotheby's Hong Kong at their 'High Jewelry' event. This stunning piece features Paraiba Tourmaline gems that have been expertly crafted and is expected to draw significant attention due to its record-breaking status.

data.title: AI Can Help CIOs Reclaim Capacity as 83% of IT Spend and 66% of Staff Time Go Toward Keeping the Lights On, Says Info-Tech Research Group
data.description: Experts predict that IT teams will play a crucial role in driving innovation, enhancing resilience, and facilitating growth, despite the majority of their resources being devoted to the upkeep of current systems and services. According to a recent blueprint by the Info-Tech Research Group, leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) can significantly reduce the expenses and effort associated with keeping the lights on (KTLO) in IT. This shift towards AI integration aims to help optimize operations while ensuring that IT departments can allocate their time and budget effectively.

data.title: TGI Fridays™ Signs Landmark Development Agreement with Devolli Group, Accelerating Global Growth with First-Ever Expansion into the Balkans
data.description: In a move to expand its global presence, iconic restaurant chain TGI Fridays™ has announced plans to open 10 new locations in Kosovo, Albania, and North Macedonia. This initiative is part of the company's strategic vision, known as 1-2-3 Strategic Vision, aimed at establishing a strong foothold in Southeast Europe. The expansion is set to act as a key growth gateway for the brand across the region and beyond. This announcement was made in Dallas on September 4, 2026.

data.title: Asana to Present at Upcoming Investor Events
data.description: Asana, Inc., a leading company on NYSE (ASAN) and LTSE (ASAN) and known as the operating system for human-agent teams, is set to present at two significant investor events. The first presentation will take place at Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference on September 9, 2026, at 7:10 a.m. PT / 10:10 a.m. ET. The second presentation will be at the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on September 15, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. PT / 2:30 p.m. ET. Interested individuals can access a live webcast of the events on Asana’s website at https://investors.asana.com. Asana focuses on providing an operating system for human-agent teams.

data.title: Grindr to Participate in the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
data.description: Grindr Inc. (NYSE: GRND) disclosed that its Chairman and CEO, George Arison, will be part of a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference in San Francisco, CA on September 10, 2026, at 3:05 PM PT. The event will feature discussions pertinent to the company and its future trajectory. Those interested can access a live webcast of the chat via Grindr’s investor relations website at https://investors.grindr.com/. For those unable to tune in live, an archived version will be available for future viewing.

data.title: Syndax Pharmaceuticals Reports Inducement Grants Under NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: Syndax Pharmaceuticals, a biopharmaceutical company traded on Nasdaq under SNDX, shared that on September 1, 2026, they provided inducement awards for the purchase of a total of 175,000 common stock shares to recruit nineteen new team members, in accordance with the 2023 Inducement Plan. The stock options will vest across four years, where 25% of the shares will be available after one year of the vesting start date, and the rest will vest monthly in 1/48 increments over the following 36 months. This process is contingent on the employees remaining with Syndax during each vesting period.

data.title: NOMAD POWER SOLUTIONS ANNOUNCES ADJOURNMENT OF SPECIAL MEETING OF STOCKHOLDERS
data.description: NOMAD Power Solutions, Inc., based in Boca Raton, Florida, and traded on Nasdaq under the symbol NMAD, was previously known as LIXTE Biotechnology Holdings. The company, specializing in transportable utility-grade battery energy storage systems through its subsidiary NOMAD Transportable Power Systems, postponed its Special Meeting of Stockholders that was set for September 4, 2026, at 1:00 PM Eastern Time. The meeting, which did not transact any business, is rescheduled for October 2, 2026, at the same time to allow NOMAD additional time to finalize its Nasdaq listing application.

data.title: Opendoor Home Loans Exits Beta With Fixed- and Adjustable-Rate Mortgages
data.description: Opendoor Home Loans has expanded its mortgage offerings to include fixed-rate options for 30, 20, and 15 years, as well as adjustable-rate mortgages like 5/6, 7/6, and 10/6. These options are available for all home purchases in markets where Opendoor Home Loans operates legally.

data.title: Apnimed, Inc. Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: On September 4, 2026, Apnimed, Inc. (Nasdaq: APMD) based in Cambridge, MA, disclosed that the compensation committee of the company's board of directors issued 10 non-executive employees with non-qualified stock options. These options allow the purchase of a total of 428,428 shares of Apnimed's common stock under the 2026 Inducement Plan. The exercise price for each share is $26.85, mirroring the closing trading price on September 1, 2026. Vesting of these stock options will occur incrementally, with one-fourth of the shares vesting on the first anniversary of the employee's start date, followed by equal monthly vesting for the subsequent three years, contingent upon the employee's continuous tenure with the company.
